newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai soybean futures end down on correction.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai soybean futures end down on correction.

text.p: Shanghai soybean futures ended mostly down on Monday on a technical correction after Friday's gains, traders said.
The most actively traded July 1997 contract ended at 3,342 yuan ($403) per tonne, losing 32 yuan. It opened at 3,350 yuan, hitting an intraday high of 3,362 and a low of 3,300 yuan.
May fell three yuan to 3,305, September lost four to 3,381, November shed seven to 3,381 and the January 1998 contract closed unchanged at 3,380 yuan per tonne.
Combined volume rose to 16,200 tonnes from 11,900 tonne.
